rng: numpy.random.Generator(PCG64(seed)); standard-normal draws are generated in C row-major order; values outside [-3,3] are rejected and redrawn in ascending flattened-index order until all are within bounds

outer_split.groups: one unique synthetic biological group per sample

inner_split.groups: synthetic biological groups restricted to outer training rows

scenario_noise_support: Every standard-normal variate used in the four DGPs is sampled from a standard normal truncated by rejection to [-3,3]. This is a negligible-tail numerical support correction that guarantees positive log2(TPM) for the frozen equations; it is not outcome-dependent.

elastic_net.eligible_gene_shortfall: retain all eligible genes up to the budget and report; no substitution

gene_expression_conversion: TPM = exp2(log2TPM) - 1; reject any nonfinite or negative value; no downstream clipping

resources.pressure_action: Before each task, wait boundedly; if pressure persists, stop with preserved checkpoints and resource_paused status; never omit tasks or alter model settings

interpretation: Finite-sample mechanism controls under explicit synthetic assumptions; not biological mechanism validation or new evidence of REO superiority; no p-values or inferential confidence intervals
